expected_direction: If the image becomes ready and the frozen stock control passes, H100 should produce a valid native-BF16 stock point; no tuned or economic advantage is predicted from this stock-only experiment.

claim_boundary: This prior is not measured evidence and cannot support a cost or co-design claim.
